title: mcp
description: DNS, IP, AS, domain reputation, and Lightning Network intelligence (44 tools)
summary: DNS, IP, AS, domain reputation, and Lightning Network intelligence (44 tools)
offersHint: DNS, IP, AS, domain reputation, and Lightning Network intelligence (44 tools) · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.robtex.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: latest_lightning_channels
toolsPreview.description: Returns the most recently opened Lightning Network channels, sorted by open time descending.

toolsPreview.name: ip_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Check an IP address reputation against 100+ real-time blocklists (DNSBLs). Returns listing status, threat categories, AS info, and blocklist details.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_dns
toolsPreview.description: Lookup DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, SOA) for a given hostname. Also returns domain reputation info (Majestic, Tranco rankings, blocklist status).

toolsPreview.name: reverse_lookup_dns_records
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that use a specific DNS record value. Query which hostnames point to an IP address, use a particular nameserver, or reference any DNS value. For example: 'which hostnames point to 1.2.3.4?' or 'which hostnames use chris.ns.cloudflare.com as their nameserver?'

toolsPreview.name: reverse_lookup_mx
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that use a specific mail server. For example: which hostnames use aspmx.l.google.com as their mail server?

toolsPreview.name: reverse_lookup_ns
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that use a specific nameserver. For example: which hostnames use chris.ns.cloudflare.com as their nameserver?

toolsPreview.name: reverse_lookup_ip
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that point to a specific IP address (IPv4 or IPv6). Searches both A and AAAA records. For example: which hostnames point to 1.2.3.4?

toolsPreview.name: historic_reverse_lookup_ns
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that *previously* used a specific nameserver but no longer do. Tracks infrastructure migrations and past delegation relationships.

toolsPreview.name: historic_reverse_lookup_mx
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that *previously* used a specific mail server but no longer do. Tracks email provider migrations and past MX relationships.

toolsPreview.name: historic_reverse_lookup_ip
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that *previously* pointed to a specific IP address but no longer do. Tracks hosting migrations and past IP relationships. Searches both A and AAAA records.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_mac
toolsPreview.description: Look up the manufacturer/vendor of a network device by its MAC address. Uses the official IEEE OUI (Organizationally Unique Identifier) database with ~30K entries.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_as_whois
toolsPreview.description: Lookup WHOIS information for an Autonomous System (AS) number from the RADB routing database. Returns routing policy, network information, and administrative contacts.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_lightning_node
toolsPreview.description: Lookup a Lightning Network node by public key. Returns node alias, peer count, channel count, and centrality ranking.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_lightning_channel
toolsPreview.description: Lookup a Lightning channel by channel ID. Supports numeric, block x txn x vout, or block:txn:vout formats.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_lightning_channels_per_node
toolsPreview.description: Lookup all Lightning Network channels for a given node by public key.

toolsPreview.name: get_recommended_lightning_peers
toolsPreview.description: Get recommended Lightning Network peers for a given node. Returns nodes that are NOT currently peered with the specified node but would improve its centrality score if connected.

toolsPreview.name: search_lightning_nodes_by_alias
toolsPreview.description: Search for Lightning Network nodes by partial alias match. Returns nodes whose aliases contain the search term (case-insensitive).

toolsPreview.name: domain_rdap
toolsPreview.description: Queries the authoritative RDAP registry for a domain. Returns availability status (HTTP 404 = available), and for registered domains: registrar name, registration/expiration dates, nameservers, DNSSEC status, and domain status flags. Uses IANA bootstrap to find the correct RDAP server per TLD. Covers 590+ TLDs.

toolsPreview.name: parse_hostname
toolsPreview.description: Parse a hostname into its constituent parts using the Mozilla Public Suffix List (9700+ entries). Returns eTLD (effective TLD), registered domain, subdomain, labels, and depth. Handles multi-level eTLDs (co.uk, co.jp, com.au) and platform suffixes (github.io, herokuapp.com).

toolsPreview.name: is_subdomain
toolsPreview.description: Check whether a hostname is a subdomain (has labels beyond the registered domain). Uses the Mozilla Public Suffix List for accurate eTLD detection.

toolsPreview.name: registered_domain
toolsPreview.description: Extract the registered domain (eTLD+1) from a hostname. For example, www.mail.example.co.uk returns example.co.uk.

toolsPreview.name: tld_info
toolsPreview.description: Get information about a top-level domain or effective TLD. Returns whether it is in the Public Suffix List, how many sub-suffixes exist, and classification (ccTLD, gTLD, or infrastructure).

toolsPreview.name: reverse_lookup_cname
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that have a CNAME record pointing to the specified target. Useful for CDN and load balancer investigations.

toolsPreview.name: historic_reverse_lookup_cname
toolsPreview.description: Find hostnames that previously had a CNAME record pointing to the specified target but no longer do. Tracks CDN and infrastructure migrations.

toolsPreview.name: ip_geolocation
toolsPreview.description: Get geographic location data for an IP address: country, city, region, latitude, longitude, timezone.

toolsPreview.name: ip_network
toolsPreview.description: Get the containing network (BGP route), AS number, AS name, and route description for an IP address.

toolsPreview.name: ip_to_asn
toolsPreview.description: Lightweight lookup: get just the AS number and netblock for an IP address. Fastest way to map IP to ASN.

toolsPreview.name: ip_blocklist_check
toolsPreview.description: Check an IP address against IPsum, FireHOL, Tor exit node lists, C2 indicators, Roskomnadzor (Russia), and other threat intelligence feeds. Returns which lists the IP appears on and threat scores.

toolsPreview.name: ip_threat_intel
toolsPreview.description: Combined threat intelligence: DNSBL listings, IPsum score, FireHOL lists, bad ASN flag, Tor exit status. Comprehensive threat assessment for an IP address.

toolsPreview.name: as_info
toolsPreview.description: Get the name, organization, country, and description for an Autonomous System number. Lightweight version of as_whois.

toolsPreview.name: as_prefixes
toolsPreview.description: Get all IPv4 and IPv6 network prefixes (netblocks) announced by an Autonomous System. Returns BGP-visible routes.

toolsPreview.name: domain_reputation
toolsPreview.description: Get comprehensive domain reputation: Majestic rank, Tranco rank, HaGeZi blocklist status, Blackbook malware status, phishing database status, HSTS preload status, and disposable email detection.

toolsPreview.name: domain_ranking
toolsPreview.description: Get domain popularity rankings from five independent sources: Majestic Million (backlinks), Tranco top 1M (aggregated traffic), Cloudflare Radar (1.1.1.1 DNS query popularity), Cisco Umbrella (OpenDNS query popularity), and Chrome UX Report (real Chrome user traffic).

toolsPreview.name: domain_blocklist_check
toolsPreview.description: Check a domain against HaGeZi DNS blocklists, Steven Black unified hosts, Blackbook malware list, phishing databases, Roskomnadzor (Russia), and Citizen Lab censorship lists. Returns which lists the domain appears on.

toolsPreview.name: dns_differential
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a domain through filtered public DNS resolvers and their unfiltered controls to detect provider threat-feed blocks.

toolsPreview.name: domain_shared_ip
toolsPreview.description: Find other domains hosted on the same IP address(es) as the target domain. Resolves the domain's A records, then performs reverse IP lookups for each.

toolsPreview.name: domain_shared_ns
toolsPreview.description: Find other domains using the same nameserver(s) as the target domain. Resolves the domain's NS records, then performs reverse NS lookups for each.

toolsPreview.name: domain_shared_mx
toolsPreview.description: Find other domains using the same mail server(s) as the target domain. Resolves the domain's MX records, then performs reverse MX lookups for each.

toolsPreview.name: check_email
toolsPreview.description: Verify an email address by connecting to its mail server via SMTP. Checks MX records, tests if the address is accepted (RCPT TO), detects catch-all domains, and reports TLS support. Results are RAM-cached for 1 hour.

toolsPreview.name: ping
toolsPreview.description: Check if the API is responding. Returns status and server timestamp.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_bitcoin_transaction
toolsPreview.description: Returns full transaction details: inputs with addresses and values, outputs with spent status, fee, size/weight, SegWit flag, and Lightning Network channel correlation. Supports both confirmed and mempool transactions.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_bitcoin_address
toolsPreview.description: Returns address balance, total received/sent, transaction counts, address type (P2PKH, P2SH, P2WPKH, P2TR), first/last seen block, and ransomware/abuse flags. Supports all Bitcoin address formats.

toolsPreview.name: lookup_bitcoin_block
toolsPreview.description: Returns block header (hash, timestamp, version, merkle root, difficulty, nonce), transaction count, and list of transaction IDs. Supports lookup by block height.

toolsPreview.name: bitcoin_address_transactions
toolsPreview.description: Returns a paginated list of transactions involving a Bitcoin address. Filter by direction: received (incoming funds), sent (outgoing funds), or all. Returns up to 100 transactions per call, sorted by block height descending (most recent first).

toolsPreview.name: bitcoin_transaction_spends
toolsPreview.description: For a given transaction, returns which subsequent transactions consumed its outputs. Useful for UTXO tracking and chain analysis. Shows the spending txid for each output.

toolsPreview.name: bitcoin_blockchain_stats
toolsPreview.description: Returns cumulative blockchain metrics over a configurable block range. Available metrics include: txs, fees, segwittx, inputs, outputs, insats, outsats, btcusd, volusd, unspentoutputs, fullyspent, unspentsats, addresses, satoshiblocks, clnopen, clnclose, satlnopen, satlnclose, basereward, blockreward, batched, rbf, version2tx, lowestfee, and more. Returns sampled data points suitable for charting.
